_about: The Events page at /nyc/events/ (engine/events_page.py). 'file' is the page's listing, written daily by fetch_happening.py next to the page; 'units' is the map's file the neighborhood filter and card outline come from. NYC Parks' feed looks two weeks ahead, so the page covers 14 days. 'words' are the page's own text; the engine names no city or source.

words.title: What’s on in New York City parks
words.intro: Every public event in New York City’s parks for the next two weeks: walks, concerts, classes, volunteer days, exhibitions and more, from NYC Parks.
words.listing: A listing, not a guide: the facts and a link to each event’s page, nothing else. The city’s libraries publish no open events feed, so their programs aren’t here.
words.desc: What’s on in New York City’s parks today, this weekend and over the next two weeks, from NYC Parks’ public events listing.
words.card: Today, this weekend, the next two weeks
words.source: Events from NYC Parks, via NYC Open Data.
